name: json2dir-hs
description: Handwritten one-file Haskell take with aeson and directory; looser than the RFC
build:
# GHC 9.6.7 from runtimes/ghcup, static cabal-install 3.14.2.0 in runtimes/cabal-3.14.2.0, Hackage index+store in runtimes/cabal-store.
# -j1: parallel downloads into drvfs lose tarballs. LIBRARY_PATH: a libgmp.so symlink so Template Haskell deps link (the libgmp-dev .a is non-PIC).
R={runtimes}; export PATH="$R/ghcup/.ghcup/bin:$PATH" CABAL_DIR="$R/cabal-store" LIBRARY_PATH="$R/cabal-3.14.2.0/gmp-lib"; mkdir -p "$R/json2dir-hs-bin" && "$R/cabal-3.14.2.0/cabal" install -j1 --builddir /tmp/json2dir-hs-kovalev-build --installdir "$R/json2dir-hs-bin" --install-method=copy --overwrite-policy=always exe:json2dir-hs
